<action type="say">I can help with that. To try to cancel before it ships, I need a bit more info:

1) How can I look up the order?
   - Either your order ID, or  
   - The email used on the order, plus shipping ZIP code (and, if possible, last 4 digits of the card).

2) Do you want to:
   - Cancel the entire order, or  
   - Only certain items? If partial, which items and quantities?

Also, if you know why you’re canceling (e.g., ordered by mistake, found a better price), share a short reason—I can include it with the cancellation request.</action>
